subject: paying my invoice
body:
Hi, I'd like to pay my invoice now so it's done. My card is 4111 1111 1111 1111, expiry 09/28, security code 123. Please run it and let me know.

Jocasta Wynne

evidence.anchor: We accept card, check and cash.

notes: 4111 1111 1111 1111 is a published test card number and passes the Luhn check. It must be masked before storage and before any model sees it. The draft should tell the customer not to send card details by email.
